section_title: Examples of predicate crimes > Environmental crime

propositions.proposition: 环境犯罪为跨国犯罪组织和其他犯罪组织提供了同时赚取和清洗资金的机会。
source_quotes: environmental crimes offer the opportunity to both earn and launder funds simultaneously

propositions.proposition: 当当局调查非法活动（环境犯罪）时，他们往往会受到腐败政府官员的阻碍，这些官员收受贿赂以阻止或隐瞒调查。
source_quotes: When authorities investigate the illicit activity, they often become hindered by corrupt government officials who have been bribed to block or hide the inquiry
